title: The roadmap build flags a new step whose title shares its key words with an open step
why: Triage filed record-at-round-head at 09:22 CST Nov 8, a duplicate of review-record-before-any-push and record-before-fix-push, because its grep used the wrong words; the coordinator had ruled one home for that defect at 07:43 CST.
note: Filed 09:44 CST Nov 8 by triage for its own mistake (rule building-mistake-names-its-guard). Fix: roadmap/build.py prints, for each step added since the last build, the open steps whose titles share two or more key words, so the writer reads them before pushing. Red case: record-at-round-head against review-record-before-any-push.
